summary: Seizure and sampling under NDPS Act without Magistrate's presence or certification; violation of Section 52A(2)-(4); samples not primary evidence; conviction vitiated for lack of primary evidence; conviction and sentence set aside; appeal allowed.
legal_provisions_cited: Union of India vs Mohanlal and Anr (2016) 3 SCC 379
final_judgment: Appeal allowed; conviction and sentence set aside; bail bonds cancelled.
